info.title: AIJ UWE benchmark — cleaned data API
info.summary: Wind-tunnel reference data of the AIJ UWE benchmark (Cases A-E), cleaned, with Eddy3D's validation against it.
info.description: Static files, one GET each; nothing is computed on request. Lengths in metres, velocities in m/s, variances and k in m^2/s^2, in one frame per case. Semantic versioning. Within a major version the API only adds: new fields, new endpoints, new runs. Clients must ignore fields they do not know. A field is renamed or removed only in a new major version, and the changelog says which. GitHub Pages sends JSON with a 10-minute max-age and CSV and ZIP files with a 186-day max-age. Every download URL therefore carries ?v=<first 12 hex digits of the file's SHA-256>: the server ignores the query, and a changed file gets a new URL. Fetch the JSON documents for the current URLs; check downloads against `sha256`.
